about: VisionClaw's evaluation set for the jobs of docs/PLAN-ten-scenarios.md, written on 2026-11-19 before anything was run on it: not the planner's patterns, not a model. In the casual words a blind person uses; none of these is one of the article's own sentences, which the patterns were written against. The last thirteen are requests that must stay with the jobs they had before, so that a new job that takes too much shows. Written by the same hand as the patterns, on the same day: a set in the owner's own words is the honest measure of what comes next. Never tune on it without writing another. One expectation was wrong and was corrected after the first run: a bare "volume" is NVDA's own volume by VisionClaw's rule, so change_setting is right for "turn the volume up to 60 percent". Same form as requests.json. Score with: VC_SET=requests-ten python tests/eval_routing.py MODELS
